conclusion: No clear protocol/lifecycle/budget blocker found in frozen CPU-reviewed opt-in implementation. Runtime efficacy remains untested; old P4 run identities must not be renamed as P5.

checks.finding: No visual_context key delegates the identical base client, caller prompt and ProjectV11RobotTools. Existing v4 SYSTEM_PROMPT and five tool schema are unchanged. Source-derived controller fingerprint changes with the edited file and must remain versioned, so this is behavior preservation, not byte-identical controller provenance.

Episode change clears both memories. Repeated observation ID cannot establish new motion/reference and requires identical simulation time; a new ID must advance time. The fixed reference is first distinct public bilateral >0.02N, explicitly not a grasp-success detector.

At most two historical wrist sources, deduplicated when previous and reference are same source; current side+wrist blocks remain byte-exact and last. Thus 2–4 JPEGs total. Historical frames retain their own stale IDs, time and wrist calibration; actions still bind the current observation.

Augmented items are sent to the existing client once. The original tools/instructions/label/deadline and extra kwargs are forwarded. The client then computes the bound and reserves the same ledger over all images. Its own retries/serial tools remain unchanged; decorator adds no HTTP calls.

Current input enforces existing public-field whitelist. Historical projection uses public robot/tactile/time and wrist calibration only. There is no environment reference, object state, teacher phase, autonomous action/stop or success rewrite.

Complete live response item groups including opaque reasoning remain in the actual input for protocol compatibility. Private/unknown typed or encrypted items are represented only by canonical SHA and type in saved projection. exact_full_input_reconstructable is false whenever redacted. When none are private, saved exact JPEGs reconstruct canonical input_items exactly. This does not reconstruct complete HTTP body, headers, instructions/tools serialization or private reasoning.

New decision folder uses exist_ok=False; preflight failure uses exclusive creation. Current public JSON and JPEG bytes must match previously saved runner artifacts before delegate. Wrong/missing artifacts or preflight protocol failure do not call provider. Reconstruction is an offline utility for trusted generated manifests; not a sandbox for arbitrary external manifests.

limitations: No actual API or GPU run of prompt5/temporal performed by this review.
Static bilateral threshold reference can be transient contact; it cannot certify force sufficiency, held pose or support.
Up to four JPEGs increases actual cost/context bound; no budget increase or cap reset is implied.
Historical frames can expose perspective/relative motion but do not provide 3D insertion depth, segmentation, exact support, or image-state synchronization proof.
